explanation: A pthread mutex is a synchronization primitive in C used to protect shared resources in multithreaded programs, preventing race conditions by allowing only one thread to access the resource at a time. Initializing it prepares the mutex for locking and unlocking operations, ensuring safe thread coordination.
example_explanation: This program includes the required headers and initializes a pthread mutex in the main function using PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER. It then prints a message to confirm the initialization, demonstrating how this sets up the mutex for use in thread synchronization without performing any actual locking or threading operations.
